title: Event correlation by Complex Event Processing
context: Repository events arrive one by one. The compliance evaluation must recognize patterns over time.
decision: Use CEP with a catalog of declarative patterns, evaluated against an SCM baseline.
consequences: New patterns go into the catalog with no change to the engine. But the engine must have a configurable time window.

alternatives.option: Aggregate SQL queries on the event database
alternatives.rejected_because: It cannot show the time relation between events without costly materialization, and it couples the rule to the schema

alternatives.option: Imperative rules coded for each pattern
alternatives.rejected_because: A new pattern would change the engine, and this violates the scenario QS-modularity

sensitivity_points: maintainability: a new pattern does not change the engine
performance_efficiency: time window of the correlation
tradeoff_points: performance_efficiency decreases when the window becomes larger to cover more patterns
risks: A window with an incorrect size gives a false negative for compliance
